[[File:Chris Schoenthal 2023 Hall of Fame.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Chris Schoenthal, inducted into the Players Committee Hall of Fame in 2023.]]
'''Chris Schoenthal''' (GEMP and forum handle '''imrahil327''')<ref name="cc1" /> has been the Players Committee's '''[[Tournament Advocate]]''' since July 2009.<ref name="vol2009" /><ref name="swcabout2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180158/http://www.starwarsccg.org/about/ About], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 9 October 2014)</ref><ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>
